interaction_alert.mechanism: Ginkgo Biloba extract inhibits Cytochrome P450 2C9 (CYP2C9) and acts as a Platelet-Activating Factor (PAF) antagonist. When combined with Warfarin, it significantly prolongs INR and increases hemorrhagic risk.
interaction_alert.patient_narrative: Do not take Ginkgo Biloba with your blood thinner (Warfarin). Ginkgo changes how your blood clots and can cause severe, unexpected bleeding.
